- Goal-Step: NATIVE-01/N3

The operator approved a manual selective release on 2026-10-21 because the automatic train excludes the Capacitor package conflict. The release preserves all CI and exact Test verification requirements. Production deployment, mobile authentication configuration and Android emulator sign-in verification are authorized; paid model calls and store submission are excluded.

The sole cherry-pick conflict was mobile package metadata. Capacitor packages are aligned to the verified 8.5.3 SDK and the native authentication plugin is retained. Authentication source did not conflict. The unchanged authentication boundary reuses accepted review `r-20261020-104941-ea6824`.

Local verification: 45 focused authentication, capability, transport and runtime-closure tests; mobile TypeScript; 197 security checks; locked dependency installation; bundled mobile build, Capacitor sync and Android debug assembly passed. Full server build and final-head CI are still pending at record creation.

Separate Test and production signing keys and refresh peppers were provisioned and validated without logging their values or triggering deployment. Test native enrollment is enabled for the candidate deployment. Production native enrollment remains disabled until the serving release is verified.

Exact Test deployment/build-info, readiness and authentication boundary evidence must be added to the PR before merge. Production deployment/readiness, actual Android email-code sign-in and cold restart evidence, and the main-to-develop back-merge run must be recorded in the PR after completion. This record does not claim those pending checks passed.
